name: conversation
title: Conversation
description: A chat or agent thread: a role="log" that follows new messages while the reader is at the end, stops when they scroll up and shows a "new below" pill that jumps back (smooth unless reduced motion), keeps a streaming message in view, loads older messages above without moving the view, and server renders. ConversationMessage is an article named by its author, with avatar, relative time and data-from (user, assistant, agent, system, tool); ConversationComposer composes Textarea and Button. Agents read messages and call jumpToLatest.
docs: `<Conversation label="Thread with Atlas" composer={<ConversationComposer onSend={send} />}>{messages.map((m) => <ConversationMessage key={m.id} messageId={m.id} from={m.from} author={m.author} avatar={…} time={m.at} now={now} streaming={m.streaming}>{m.text}</ConversationMessage>)}</Conversation>`. Give it a bounded height (it fills its parent). It renders every message: keep a window of the newest few hundred in state and pass `hasOlder` and `onLoadOlder` (add the older ones in one update) for longer threads. A streaming message sets `aria-busy`, so screen readers read it once it is whole. `useConversation()` inside it returns `jumpToLatest`, `release` and `loadOlder`. Labels (`newBelow(count)`, `jumpToLatest`, `loadOlder`, the composer's `message` and `send`, and the screen-reader names per role) are overridable.
